newsitem.title: USA: Natgas futures end lower, longs hit Oct at expiry.
newsitem.headline: Natgas futures end lower, longs hit Oct at expiry.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures ended down Tuesday in an active session, with long liquidation, particularly in the expiring October contract, dragging the complex lower, industry sources said.
October expired 4.5 cents lower at $1.828 per million British thermal units. November slipped 1.7 cents to close at $2.055. Other deferreds ended down by 0.2 to two cents.

"A lot of people got long on the breakout and had to get out, but it was a lot more orderly than I expected," said one Houston-based trader, adding November was soon likely to test key support in the $1.98 area.
With little cooling demand on the horizon and storage injections soon likely to fall off, most expected the bulls to remain on the defensive for a while.

And technically, traders said November's break Monday of the up trendline set a bearish tone and should lead to more selling near-term. They said a November close below support in the $1.98-$2.00 area should mean a test of the recent low at $1.90. Resistance was seen at $2.12 and then at the recent high of $2.305.

Cash sources said Gulf Coast prices were steady to down slightly Tuesday to the mid-$1.80s, with swing gas at the Hub talked two cents lower at near the $1.90 level. October Gulf gas was quoted at even with NYMEX to 10 cents under the screen. Midcon pipes edged up slightly to the mid-$1.70s on cooler weather there, with Oct Midcon in the high-$1.60s. October New York city gate gas was pegged in the $2.05-2.10 area.
The 12-month Henry Hub strip eased 0.8 cent to $2.046.
NYMEX October Permian natgas settled 1.5 cents lower at $1.625. NYMEX October Permian natgas expires Thursday, Sept 26.

On the KCBT, October finished 4.4 cents lower at $1.646, while deferreds ended up by one-half to one cent. The East/West spread narrowed by 0.1 cent to 18.2 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT said 844 contracts traded, up from Monday's total of 466.
KCBT October natgas expires Wednesday, Sept 25.
